success.instructions: Did the agent accomplish what the user asked in this turn (correctly and completely)?

criteria.true: the request was fulfilled correctly and completely
criteria.false: the request was not fulfilled, only partly, or wrongly

failure_mode.instructions: What is the main way this turn failed (none if it succeeded)?

criteria.none: no failure: the request was fulfilled
criteria.wrong_result: the agent produced a result that is wrong or does not do what was asked
criteria.incomplete: part of the request was left undone or the work stopped early
criteria.broke_something: the agent damaged or regressed something that worked before
criteria.ignored_instruction: the agent disregarded an explicit instruction or constraint of the user
criteria.looped_or_stuck: the agent repeated failing actions or made no progress
criteria.blocked_external: an external blocker (missing access, tool/service outage, missing input) prevented the work
criteria.unverified_claim: the final reply claims success that the steps do not support

rework.instructions: Will the user have to ask for a fix/redo of this turn's work?

criteria.true: the user will need to correct or redo this work
criteria.false: the user can accept this work as it is
